candidateDescriptionEn: For a coil with N equivalent turns, the learner can determine the instantaneous induced voltage from the common oriented differentiable magnetic flux Φ(t) per turn using U_ind(t) = −N · dΦ(t)/dt and physically interpret the voltage’s time dependence.
